module.purpose: Embeds web fonts used by exported SVG content as data URLs in generated @font-face CSS declarations.
module.summary: This module collects font-face definitions from a document's accessible and fetched stylesheets, including recursively imported stylesheets. During SVG traversal it records referenced font families, resolves matching font resources, asynchronously converts external resources to data URLs, and produces CSS with embedded font declarations. It filters stylesheets belonging to temporary SVG export nodes and avoids duplicate font-family and font-face processing.
module.businessContext: Supports reliable SVG export when web fonts cannot remain externally referenced. If it fails, exported diagrams may render with missing or substituted fonts.

systemCapabilities: Embed external fonts into SVG CSS

io: Reads document stylesheets, stylesheet rules, owner nodes, and document base URI.

Converts referenced font resources into data URLs.
mutationOfArg: Mutates ParsedFontFace URL records by assigning embedding promises to url.embedded.

edgeCases.inputShape: Repeated font-family value or repeated individual font name
edgeCases.behavior: The font name is skipped after its first encounter.

edgeCases.inputShape: Stylesheet belonging to a temporary SVG export node
edgeCases.behavior: The stylesheet is excluded from document traversal.
The stylesheet is fetched by href when available.

edgeCases.inputShape: Font face with unresolved or already embedded resource URL
edgeCases.behavior: That URL is not sent for data URL conversion.

edgeCases.inputShape: Resource conversion returns no data URL
edgeCases.behavior: The original resource reference is retained in the generated declaration.

edgeCases.inputShape: No matching font faces or no usable stylesheets
edgeCases.behavior: The method returns an empty CSS string.

errorHandling.action: Rejects a second document font-face initialization.
Suppresses the access error and attempts stylesheet fetching when href exists.
errorHandling.fallback: Fetches styleSheet.href or contributes no rules when href is absent.

invariants.description: Document font-face discovery may be started only once per embedder instance.
Font-family values must not be processed before document font-face discovery starts.
Each encountered font family is scheduled at most once.
Each matching parsed font face is added to the embedding set at most once.
Generated CSS contains only font-face declarations with successfully resolved embedded resources.

assumptions.description: Callers initialize document font discovery before submitting font-family values.
The document provides stylesheet and CSS rule APIs, with defaultView supplying CSSFontFaceRule and CSSImportRule constructors when available.
Parsed font faces expose fontFamilies, urls, fontFace, and import-compatible parsed CSS fields.

ambiguities.question: Does fetchCache deduplicate requests and how does it surface network failures?
What exact CSS parsing and font-family normalization rules are applied by the imported parser?

concurrencyModel.notes: Font discovery and resource conversion are asynchronous and may run concurrently; output iteration follows insertion order of the embedding set.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Calling onFontFamilyValue before document font-face discovery has started is rejected.
moduleContractTests.then: throws an assertion error with message 'FontEmbedder not started'
moduleContractTests.rationale: Font family collection requires the document font-face promise to be initialized.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Starting document font-face discovery more than once is rejected.
moduleContractTests.then: throws an assertion error with message 'FontEmbedder already started'
moduleContractTests.rationale: The embedder owns one immutable discovery promise for its lifecycle.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Processing the same font family repeatedly does not schedule duplicate font-face work.
moduleContractTests.then: createCss() fetches and embeds each matching font face at most once
moduleContractTests.rationale: foundFontNames and fontFacesToEmbed prevent duplicate processing and embedding.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Creating CSS after a used font has a resolvable external URL replaces that URL with its data URL.
moduleContractTests.then: returns CSS containing '@font-face' declarations with embedded data URLs instead of the original font URLs
moduleContractTests.rationale: SVG output must remain self-contained without external font resources.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Creating CSS without collecting any font family returns no declarations.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Only font faces referenced by collected font-family values are emitted.

module.moduleLevelCode:
import { assert, bind, compact } from '@tldraw/utils'
import { fetchCache, resourceToDataUrl } from './fetchCache'
import { ParsedFontFace, parseCss, parseCssFontFaces, parseCssFontFamilyValue } from './parseCss'

units.name: FontEmbedder

detail.name: FontEmbedder
detail.summary: FontEmbedder collects document font-face definitions referenced by observed font-family values and produces CSS with eligible font resources embedded as data URLs.

units.name: onFontFamilyValue

detail.name: onFontFamilyValue
preconditions: The FontEmbedder has been started and fontFacesPromise is initialized.
postconditions: Each newly encountered parsed font family is added to foundFontNames.
A pending promise is added for each newly encountered font family.
When font face data resolves, matching font faces are added to fontFacesToEmbed and unresolved, unembedded URLs are assigned resourceToDataUrl results.
invariants: A font family already present in foundFontNames is not processed again.
A font face already present in fontFacesToEmbed is not added or processed again.
A URL is not fetched when it is unresolved or already embedded.
edgeCases: If fontFacesPromise is not initialized, the method throws an assertion error before parsing or mutating tracking state.
If the parsed font-family list is empty, no font family or pending promise is added.
If a parsed font family has already been found, the method returns immediately and does not process subsequent parsed font families.
If no resolved font faces match a newly encountered family, the pending callback performs no embedding work.
If a matching URL is unresolved or already embedded, it is skipped; otherwise resourceToDataUrl is invoked and its result is assigned to url.embedded.

raises: Assertion error when fontFacesPromise is absent
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Throws if the FontEmbedder has not been started; otherwise parsing and asynchronous promise errors follow the underlying parser or promise behavior.

stateMutations: Adds parsed font family names to foundFontNames.
Appends asynchronous processing promises to pendingPromises.
Adds matching font face objects to fontFacesToEmbed.
Assigns the resourceToDataUrl promise or result to eligible URL objects' embedded property.
detail.summary: Registers font families referenced by a CSS font-family value and schedules discovery and embedding of matching, unresolved font resources. Repeated font families are not processed again.

specLiterals.role: Assertion message raised when fontFacesPromise has not been initialized.

specTests.when: onFontFamilyValue is called with any string.
specTests.then: The call throws an assertion error with the message "FontEmbedder not started" and does not schedule font-face processing.

specTests.when: onFontFamilyValue is called with that value and the pending callback runs.
specTests.then: The family is recorded, one pending promise is added, the matching font face is recorded in fontFacesToEmbed, and resourceToDataUrl is invoked for the URL with its result assigned to url.embedded.

specTests.when: onFontFamilyValue is called with an input containing that family.
specTests.then: The method returns immediately without adding another pending promise or processing later parsed families.

units.name: createCss

detail.name: createCss
preconditions: The instance provides iterable pendingPromises and fontFacesToEmbed collections.
Each queued font face provides a fontFace string and an iterable urls collection.
Each URL entry provides original, embedded, and an embedded result that is either awaitable or falsy.
postconditions: All pendingPromises have settled successfully before font-face processing begins.
The returned value is the concatenation of one @font-face block for each entry in fontFacesToEmbed, in iteration order.
For each URL with a truthy embedded result, the awaited data URL replaces occurrences of that URL's original value in its font-face block.
URLs with embedded set to falsey values, or whose awaited embedded result is falsey, do not alter the corresponding font-face block.
invariants: The order of fontFacesToEmbed is preserved in the returned CSS.
Each font-face block is initially formatted as @font-face { followed by the fontFace value and then }.
The method does not mutate the pendingPromises, fontFacesToEmbed, font-face entries, or URL entries.
edgeCases: An empty fontFacesToEmbed collection produces an empty string after pendingPromises settle.
A URL with a falsey embedded value is skipped without awaiting or replacing its original value.
A URL whose awaited embedded value is falsey is skipped without replacing its original value.
If a pending promise or an awaited embedded promise rejects, createCss rejects and does not return CSS.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a string formed by concatenating blocks in the format @font-face {<fontFace>} with no separator between blocks. Embedded URL values replace their corresponding original values within each block.
detail.summary: Waits for pending font processing and returns CSS containing the font faces queued for embedding, replacing successfully embedded original URLs with their data URLs.

specLiterals.role: Defines the serialized wrapper format for each emitted font-face block.

specTests.then: It resolves to the empty string.
The returned promise rejects with that rejection rather than returning CSS.

units.name: getDocumentFontFaces

detail.name: getDocumentFontFaces
preconditions: doc is a Document-like object with styleSheets, baseURI, and defaultView or a usable global CSS rule environment.
postconditions: Stylesheets associated with SVG export elements are not inspected.
Accessible CSSFontFaceRule entries are passed to the CSS font-face parser.
CSSImportRule entries and stylesheets whose cssRules cannot be accessed are scheduled for external CSS font-face fetching.
invariants: The temporary SVG export stylesheet filter is applied before stylesheet inspection.
A stylesheet's base URL is its href when available, otherwise doc.baseURI.
An imported stylesheet URL is resolved relative to its parent stylesheet href when available, otherwise doc.baseURI.
edgeCases: When doc.defaultView is nullish, the global environment is used for CSS rule constructors.
When accessing a stylesheet's cssRules throws, the stylesheet is fetched by href if href is available.
When a stylesheet has no accessible cssRules and no href, it contributes no font-face fetch.
When a stylesheet contains no CSSFontFaceRule or CSSImportRule, it contributes no discovered font faces.
Stylesheets whose owner node is within an element matching the SVG export class are excluded.
detail.summary: Inspects a document's accessible stylesheets and discovers CSS font-face definitions, including fonts referenced through CSS imports or inaccessible external stylesheets. Stylesheets belonging to temporary SVG exports are excluded.

units.name: fetchCssFontFaces

detail.name: fetchCssFontFaces
preconditions: The input URL must be acceptable to the underlying fetch/cache mechanism.
Fetched CSS responses must expose text content and a response URL.
postconditions: Returns a Promise resolving to parsed font-face records from the fetched stylesheet and its recursively imported stylesheets.
invariants: Imported stylesheet URLs are resolved relative to the URL of the stylesheet that declares them.
All imported stylesheets are processed asynchronously before the resolved result is produced.
edgeCases: A stylesheet with no imports is parsed without recursive fetches.
A stylesheet with multiple imports processes each imported URL asynchronously.
Malformed CSS or a failed fetch propagates the underlying parsing or fetch error unless the fetch/cache mechanism handles it.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Not specified; errors from URL resolution, fetching, response.text(), or CSS parsing propagate.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Accepts a stylesheet URL through the cached fetch wrapper and returns Promise<ParsedFontFace[]>; CSS imports are resolved as URLs relative to the importing response URL.
detail.summary: Fetches CSS from a URL, parses its font-face declarations, and resolves font faces referenced through CSS imports. The result is a promise of parsed font-face records.

specTests.when: fetchCssFontFaces is called for the stylesheet URL.
specTests.then: Each imported URL is resolved against the parent response URL and its font faces are fetched and included in the resulting parsed font-face collection.
